source_row.stem: A nursing informatics specialist's role primarily involves:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Providing direct bedside clinical care exclusively, without any dedicated focus on information systems or data quality","B":"A role generally considered to have no clearly defined scope within most modern healthcare organizations today","C":"Integrating nursing science with information and technology management to support clinical decision-making and data quality","D":"Repairing IT hardware exclusively, without any broader focus on nursing data, workflows, or clinical systems"}}
source_row.rationale: Nursing informatics specialists integrate nursing science with information and technology management, supporting clinical decision-making, EHR optimization, and data quality within healthcare organizations.
source_row.source_name: ANA — Nursing Informatics Scope and Standards
